summary: scripts/evidence-verify never fetches lazily: checking a record's subject commit and projecting an input key no longer trigger partial-clone fetches, which made the gate's verifier time out (unavailable) on pull requests with input-keyed records (55 s to 1.5 s in a reproduction).

replay.detail: Verifier behavior only: the same records give the same verdict and the same key.

rules.detail: A subject commit the checkout lacks was already treated as for a shallow fetch (the signer's claim stands); now it is never fetched to find out. A tree id never depended on blobs being present.

compatibility.detail: The gate runs the base's verifier, so the fix applies to runs whose base includes it.
